caption:
Both paths get people into developer jobs. They cost different things.

A gets you inside: a real codebase, real users, a salary, and teammates who can refer you. The catch: an internal move isn't guaranteed, and many companies set a minimum time in your current role before you can apply internally.

B keeps your title and your time focused on development: projects, DSA and interviews. The catch: six months with no income and no work experience, and interviewers will ask about the gap.

If you made either move, how long did it take, and would you do it again?
